items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Stuart -- Ellington knew him, knew him very well.

ctx.x: And Dr. DuBois. And then there was another very prominent from Howard University. Gee, I can't think of his name. It was Stuart -- I just can't think of his last name. But he was a great jazz historian. They had textbooks on jazz way back then.
